    Proposition 5.4 for a filtered algebra #

    prop:filtered-normal-form: "Let E be a finite filtered algebra, or a finite filtered category with the vertices of Q as objects, with a specified graded identification gr E = C. Then E is isomorphic to C by a map inducing that identification."

    The category case is GeneralNormalForm.normalForm. For an algebra E with a finite multiplicative filtration and symbols σ_d : F^d → C_d into the algebra C = ⊕_{x,y} C(x, y) (CatAlg.Alg of the relation category; FilteredAlg), the vertex idempotents of C lift to orthogonal idempotents f_x of E through the nilpotent ideal F¹; the corners f_x E f_y form a k-linear category (CornerCat) with the induced filtration and symbols (FilteredAlg.toFilteredId); the category case gives a full and faithful functor from C, and summing over the corners gives an algebra isomorphism C ≅ E inducing the identification (normalForm_algebra). The same assembly applied to normalFormRetained gives Proposition 12.2 for an algebra: E ≅ kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r_v − Σ_j λ_j (p_j)_v) inducing the identification (normalFormRetained_algebra).

                    ∃ (φ : (x y : V) → ((RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj x) ⟶ (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj y)) →ₗ[k] E'), (∀ (x y : V) (P : LinearPaths.obj x ⟶ LinearPaths.obj y), (φ x y) ((RelationCategory.functor k R).map P) = ↑((realize (fun {x y : V} => L) x y) P)) ∧ (∀ (x y : V) (c : (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj x) ⟶ (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj y)), (φ x y) c ∈ corner k f x y) ∧ (∀ (x y z : V) (c : (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj x) ⟶ (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj y)) (c' : (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj y) ⟶ (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj z)), (φ x z) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c c') = (φ x y) c * (φ y z) c') ∧ (∀ (x : V), (φ x x) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id ((RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj x))) = f x) ∧ (∀ (x y : V) (c : (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj x) ⟶ (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj y)), (φ x y) c = 0 → c = 0) ∧ ∀ (x y : V), ∀ a ∈ corner k f x y, ∃ (c : (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj x) ⟶ (RelationCategory.functor k R).obj (LinearPaths.obj y)), (φ x y) c = a

                    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.GeneralNormalForm.normalForm_algebra {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {ι : Type} {s t : ι → V} {r : (i : ι) → LinearPaths.obj (s i) ⟶ LinearPaths.obj (t i)} {E : Type u} [Ring E] [Algebra k E] (A : FilteredAlg s t r E) (hr : ∀ (i : ι), r i ∈ LinearPaths.degreePart 2 (s i) (t i)) (hDsurj : ∀ (q' : ℕ), 2 ≤ q' → ∀ (g : (i : ι) → (cl s t r).obj (LinearPaths.obj (s i)) ⟶ (cl s t r).obj (LinearPaths.obj (t i))), (∀ (i : ι), g i ∈ Cdeg s t r (q' + 1) (s i) (t i)) → ∃ (f : {x y : V} → (x ⟶ y) → ((cl s t r).obj (LinearPaths.obj x) ⟶ (cl s t r).obj (LinearPaths.obj y))), (∀ {x y : V} (a : x ⟶ y), f a ∈ Cdeg s t r q' x y) ∧ ∀ (i : ι), Dmap (fun {x y : V} => f) i = g i) :
                    ∃ (Ψ : CatAlg.Alg (clObj s t r) ≃ₐ[k] E), ∀ (d : ℕ) (c : CatAlg.Alg (clObj s t r)), (∀ (x y : V), c x y ∈ Cdeg s t r d x y) → Ψ c ∈ A.F d ∧ (A.σ d) (Ψ c) = c

                    Proposition 5.4 (prop:filtered-normal-form) for a filtered algebra: under the hypotheses of the general form (quadratic relations, surjective D_{q-1} for q ≥ 3), a finite filtered algebra E with a graded identification gr E = C is isomorphic to the category algebra of C by a map inducing that identification: it sends C_d into F^d E with symbol the identity.

                    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.GeneralNormalForm.normalFormRetained_algebra {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {ι : Type} {s t : ι → V} {r : (i : ι) → LinearPaths.obj (s i) ⟶ LinearPaths.obj (t i)} {E : Type u} [Ring E] [Algebra k E] (A : FilteredAlg s t r E) {J : Type} [Fintype J] {deg : J → ℕ} {p : J → (i : ι) → LinearPaths.obj (s i) ⟶ LinearPaths.obj (t i)} (hdeg : ∀ (j : J), 3 ≤ deg j) (hp : ∀ (j : J) (i : ι), p j i ∈ LinearPaths.degreePart (deg j) (s i) (t i)) (hr : ∀ (i : ι), r i ∈ LinearPaths.degreePart 2 (s i) (t i)) (hspan : ∀ (q' : ℕ), 2 ≤ q' → ∀ (g : (i : ι) → (cl s t r).obj (LinearPaths.obj (s i)) ⟶ (cl s t r).obj (LinearPaths.obj (t i))), (∀ (i : ι), g i ∈ Cdeg s t r (q' + 1) (s i) (t i)) → ∃ (f : {x y : V} → (x ⟶ y) → ((cl s t r).obj (LinearPaths.obj x) ⟶ (cl s t r).obj (LinearPaths.obj y))) (c : J → k), (∀ {x y : V} (a : x ⟶ y), f a ∈ Cdeg s t r q' x y) ∧ (∀ (j : J), deg j ≠ q' + 1 → c j = 0) ∧ ∀ (i : ι), g i = Dmap (fun {x y : V} => f) i + ∑ j : J, c j • (cl s t r).map (p j i)) :
                    ∃ (lam : J → k) (Ψ : (CatAlg.Alg fun (x : V) => (RelationCategory.functor k (RelRet r p lam A.N)).obj (LinearPaths.obj x)) ≃ₐ[k] E), ∀ (d : ℕ) (P : (x y : V) → LinearPaths.obj x ⟶ LinearPaths.obj y), (∀ (x y : V), P x y ∈ LinearPaths.degreePart d x y) → (Ψ fun (x y : V) => (RelationCategory.functor k (RelRet r p lam A.N)).map (P x y)) ∈ A.F d ∧ (A.σ d) (Ψ fun (x y : V) => (RelationCategory.functor k (RelRet r p lam A.N)).map (P x y)) = fun (x y : V) => (cl s t r).map (P x y)

                    Proposition 12.2 (prop:characteristic-two-normal-form) for a filtered algebra: under the hypotheses of normalFormRetained (quadratic relations, retained tuples p_j of degrees ≥ 3 whose classes together with im D_{q-1} span), every finite filtered algebra E with a graded identification gr E = C has a presentation E ≅ kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r_v − Σ_j λ_j (p_j)_v) (the category algebra of the relation category RelRet r p λ N, with F^N E = 0) for some scalars λ, and the isomorphism induces the identification: it sends the class of a family of degree-d path combinations into F^d E, with symbol its class in C.
